metadata.title: NASA-SSH Global Mean Sea Level from Gridded Sea Surface Height
metadata.description: Time series of globally averaged sea level change estimated from satellite observations of sea surface height anomaly. GMSL is calculated as the area-weighted average over each map in the Simple Gridded Sea Surface Height series.
metadata.provider: NASA-SSH / NASA Physical Oceanography Distributed Active Archive Center (PO.DAAC)
metadata.source_dataset: NASA-SSH Simple Gridded Sea Surface Height from Standardized Reference Missions Only, Version 1.1
metadata.citation: NASA-SSH. 2025. Global Mean Sea Level from Simple Gridded Sea Surface Height from Standardized Reference Missions Only Version 1. PO.DAAC, CA, USA.

measurement_columns.gmsl_60_day_smoothed_cm: Global mean sea level with 60-day smoothing applied (cm)

metadata.temporal_sampling: A new time step approximately every 7 days; each map uses 10 days of observations, so successive steps overlap slightly.
metadata.reference_period: Estimates shifted to have zero mean over calendar year 1993.
metadata.glacial_isostatic_adjustment: Not adjusted for Glacial Isostatic Adjustment (GIA).
